biotools.summary: NiMARE is a Python package implementing coordinate-based meta-regression (CBMR) for analyzing neuroimaging data, specifically functional MRI (fMRI). It enables flexible meta-regression and inference for multiple groups, allowing researchers to synthesize findings from multiple neuroimaging studies.
